main.headline: One governed home for every client record
main.deck: Content + AI across advisory, operations and compliance — without moving off the systems your teams already run.

paragraphs: **The challenge:** Advisory agreements, suitability files and client records sit across four systems. Every copy is another version to keep current, and another place a regulator can find an inconsistency.
**The solution:** Box holds the file once and surfaces it everywhere else. Access is set on the folder, retention runs automatically, and every open is logged.
